results.content: Experience of supervising Undergraduate and/or Postgraduate dissertation projects is essential, alongside the ability to maintain a visible and professional on-site presence at Aston London.At Grade 9, candidates will also demonstrate leadership in teaching, such as curriculum innovation, programme leadership, or mentoring of teaching colleagues, and will contribute to the ongoing strategic development of Aston London provision.The postholder will report to the Head of the Marketing and Entrepreneurship Department based in Birmingham.This role may meet the requirements for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship.If you require sponsorship, Aston University will assess eligibility if you are shortlisted for the role. For informal enquiries about the position please contact Queenie Poon, IT Admin Assistant, queenie.poon@uwl.ac.uk  Additional Information  Read more about working at the University of West London at https://www.uwl.ac.uk/about-us/how-university-works/why-work-uwl This is an excellent way to apply your skills, expand your knowledge and work on a diverse range of projects delivering real value to our users.
